notes: Package names are resolved against the current Ubuntu 24.04 repositories when an offline bundle is built.
Kernel drivers such as bcm5974, hid_apple, applesmc, apple_gmux, btusb and uvcvideo are not replaced by these packages.
Conditional and experimental sets are never auto-installed without matching evidence.
Optical-drive/audio workflow packages; optional for a minimal rescue bundle.

preconditions: Broadcom wireless controller must be identified by PCI ID.
The selected support case must require the wl/Broadcom STA path.
Do not install as a generic Broadcom fix.

notes: firmware-b43-installer normally downloads proprietary firmware at install time.
For offline use, the bundle must contain a captured firmware/b43 payload; the offline installer will not rely on a network download.
Ubuntu still ships pommed as an Apple laptop hotkey event handler, but modern GNOME/kernel hotkey handling must be tested first to avoid duplicate policy daemons.
Alternative fan-control daemons. Never install both automatically and never change thermal policy without sensor/fan verification.
